preconditions.description: The input values n and m must satisfy 1 ≤ m ≤ n ≤ 100,000 and n - m ≤ 2000.

preconditions.expression: len(s) == m and all(c in '()' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s must have length m and consist only of '(' and ')' characters.

postconditions.description: The output must be a non-negative integer representing the number of valid pairs (p, q) modulo 10^9 + 7.

postconditions.expression: int(stdout) == sum(1 for p in generate_possible_p(s) for q in generate_possible_q(s, p) if is_valid(p + s + q)) % (10**9 + 7)
postconditions.description: The output must equal the count of valid pairs (p, q) such that p + s + q is a valid sequence of round brackets, modulo 10^9 + 7.
